overview: Shadow Valley is the primary battlefield of Terror of Luclin’s shadow war, where Akhevan forces and void entities converge.
history: Initial fractures appeared along Luclin’s surface as Akhevan rituals intensified.
Shadow energy seeped into natural valleys, forming the Shadow Front and Corrupted Grove.
Void-Scar Pass became the controlled corridor for Akhevan transit.
The Akhevan Forward Camp established a permanent foothold inside the valley.
The Shadow Rift Basin, Lowlands, and Void-Fracture Sanctum formed the inner corruption engine of Luclin.
campaignHooks: Stop Akhevan high rituals before they tear Shadow Valley open.
Stabilize fractures and conduits to prevent valley-wide collapse.
Disrupt Praesertum command structures directing the shadow war.
Trace void entities back to their source in the Sanctum.
